tasks.label: clean
args: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force '${workspaceFolder}\bin','${workspaceFolder}\obj' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${workspaceFolder}\bin' | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${workspaceFolder}\obj' | Out-Null

tasks.label: compile
args: cd '${workspaceFolder}'; cl.exe /EHsc /Zi /Od /Fo:obj\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj /Fd:obj\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdb /Fe:bin\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe '${file}' /link user32.lib gdi32.lib shell32.lib EasyXa.lib EasyXw.lib /PDB:obj\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdb

tasks.label: run
args: if (Test-Path 'bin\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe') { & 'bin\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe' } else { Write-Host 'Executable not found. Please run compile first.' }
